company_info.description: Watt Mann Co., Ltd. engages in the operation of a chain of retail stores that offer reused products in Japan, North America, Asia, Europe, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Products Business and New Products E-Commerce Business. The company purchases and sells digital home appliances, such as computers, TVs, smartphones, refrigerators, and musical instruments; household appliances comprising microwave ovens, refrigerators, and washing machines; and hobby products, including musical instruments, hobbies, and bicycles. It also deals in household goods, including tableware, gifts, interiors goods, and gift certificates; and clothes, bags, shoes, and accessories, as well as high-priced items, such as branded items and precious metals. In addition, the company offers products for children, outdoor equipment, and sporting goods; books, CDs, DVDs, game consoles, and game software through franchise stores; hobby merchandise, including games, figures, anime, trading cards, plastic models, and anime goods; sports and camping supplies, such golf, tennis, marine and winter sports, fitness, tents, sleeping bags, and camping clothing; and camera accessories and digital cameras, including SLR, mirrorless, compact, video, rangefinder, lenses, and film cameras. It also offers products online. Watt Mann Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
